Added: Added Test source in the playback-error dialog. It samples up to 8 KB of the initial stream response and reports HTTP status, redirects and whether the response looks like an HLS playlist, HTML page, media data or an empty response.
Source-test results are included in local diagnostics without streaming URLs, credentials, headers or response contents. Cookies are not forwarded to a different origin during source-test redirects.

Diagnostic exports include device model, Android/OS build, app version and locale-region setting, with connection-type snapshots and playback preparation/error state. No IP addresses, device identifiers or precise location are collected.

With logging enabled, the small initial-response source check runs automatically when a playback error is shown. The manual Test source action remains available; response bodies and credentials are never written to logs.
Changed: The source test checks access to the initial response only. It does not establish segment access or codec compatibility, and is not presented as a confirmed fix for the reported playback failure.

Fixed: Titles with populated non-animation genre metadata, such as Doctor Who (1996), no longer require a country field to be classified as Movies or TV Shows.
Previously cached unverified results are re-evaluated using their saved genre metadata, so affected titles recover in global and category searches without clearing app data.
Changed: Animated titles without origin evidence remain unverified unless explicit anime metadata is available. Missing genre metadata is not treated as proof of a regular movie.

Added: Added app-wide local diagnostic logging for navigation, network requests, playback, update checks and errors, with view, enable/disable, clear and export controls under Settings → App diagnostics / export logs.

Diagnostic logs are size-limited and stay on the device until explicitly exported. Logs exclude titles, search text, full URLs, passwords, cookies, authorization headers, response bodies and exception messages.
Changed: Removed the private Crunchyroll import experiment and its test-library tabs. Upgrades from experimental builds clean up retired importer browser data, temporary captures and test-library preferences while preserving the main library.
Watch History now contains only episodes marked watched. Unwatched episodes appear in Continue Watching; Finished Episodes remains watched-only.
Marking an episode watched or unwatched moves it between the appropriate views while preserving its resume position, saved history, seasons and numeric episode order.
Tapping Next episode now marks the episode being left as watched before opening the next episode. Resume positions and actual watch time are preserved.

Saved episodes inside Watch History are grouped into seasons and sorted numerically, such as 1, 2, 3 and 10, instead of by last-viewed time. The same saved-season layout is used in Finished Episodes and Continue Watching.
Added: Saved episode metadata retains season, episode number and source order so editing an episode title does not change its place in history. Older records use the season/episode information already present in their titles and URLs.

Fixed: Scoped searches now check title-page category, genre and production-country metadata, including structured data, to identify untagged anime without requiring a matching dubbed/subbed listing.
Titles with unverified categories are withheld from restricted searches instead of being assumed to be normal Movies/TV results. Discover continues to include them.
Added: Added Category info on title pages, with a copyable diagnostic summary of the extracted genres, countries and category.
Added an all-category search action when titles could not be classified.
Changed: Category lookups are cached and run in parallel with a 25-second overall wait limit. Animation with Japanese origin is classified as Anime; other animation is not automatically treated as anime.

Fixed: Unmarked alternate listings of a known anime title are now classified as Anime before search filtering, including listings without a DUB/SUB prefix.
Recognized anime classification is retained across app restarts so an unmarked version stays out of general Movies/TV searches when it appears alone later.
Changed: Alternate-title matching requires the normalized full title and movie/series format, supported by a matching release year or cover image. Conflicting years are rejected, and no language/edition is guessed.

Fixed: Anime films no longer appear in general Movies searches, and anime series no longer appear in general TV Shows searches. Anime remains searchable in its own categories and in Discover.
Selecting an anime or Movies/TV category link clears an incompatible previous media-type filter.
Changed: Non-anime animated movies remain in Movies; anime search still respects the selected dubbed/subbed and movie/series category.

Added: Search now stays within the active sidebar catalogue, including Movies, TV Shows, anime selections and Audiobooks. Searching from Discover includes all categories.
Search headings and input hints show the active scope. Clearing a search returns to the same catalogue.
Fixed: Audiobook searches now submit the entered query instead of reloading the audiobook browse page.
Search results are filtered using returned or previously saved content metadata before any catalogue-context labels are applied.

Added: Added current-show or audiobook artwork to the playback notification and media session, enabling artwork backgrounds on supported Android/One UI media controls.
Uses the title banner when available, with the show or book cover as fallback.
Changed: Artwork loads in the background without delaying playback and stays with the playback service while the app is minimized or the phone is locked.
Switching titles clears old artwork; late image responses are ignored after a source change or Stop. Existing playback controls are retained.

Added: Added Remove on Continue Watching show cards and inside each saved show. Removal hides the show from that list while keeping watch history, watched status and resume positions.
Added Undo removal for the last removed show. Starting an episode from a hidden show again also restores it to Continue Watching.
Changed: Continue Watching removals persist on this device when the app is reopened.
Fixed: Missing or failed show covers in Watch History, Finished Episodes and Continue Watching now trigger a background lookup on the title page. Recovered cover links are saved for future visits.
Expanded title-page cover parsing to handle alternate image metadata and lazy poster elements.
Finished Episodes, Watch History and Continue Watching now group saved episodes by show instead of displaying a flat episode list.
Changed: Show cards use the same responsive poster grid as search results. Tap a card to view that show’s saved episodes, resume positions and watched controls.
Show titles and covers are saved with new history entries. Older history uses saved show information or a recognizable title URL when available.

Added: Added an offline Changelog in Settings and the navigation menu, with version numbers, dates and grouped changes.
Included release history back to 0.6.4 so users can review earlier fixes.
Changed: GitHub release notes now list Added, Fixed and Changed items and link to the full changelog.
The publisher checks that release notes, the GitHub changelog and the app's bundled history match before publishing.

Fixed: Removed the duplicate AnimeDubSerie option that returned an empty listing.
Redirected the old dubbed-series category to AnimeDubSeries.
Changed: Renamed anime categories to clear Dubbed/Subbed movies/series labels.

Fixed: Playback now pauses when leaving Player for the episode list, Discover, Favorites or history.
Leaving the Player screen while a source is preparing also prevents it from starting later.
Changed: Saved playback positions are retained; minimizing or locking the phone from Player still allows background playback.
Replaced the app icon with the supplied popcorn artwork.
Added proportional icon scaling, adaptive launcher shapes, safe padding and themed-icon support.
Version-only update from 0.6.5 to test in-app updating. No feature or behavior changes.

Added: Added GitHub update checks whenever the app opens or returns to the foreground.
Added Settings controls for manual checks, automatic checks, Update, Later and Skip this version.
Added background APK downloads and verification of checksum, package, version and signing certificate before installation.

Changed: Kept the video decoder output alive in the playback service while the app is minimized or locked.
Returning to Player reconnects the visible video window without recreating the decoder output, targeting interruptions on app return.
